borrow.methodology_note: Official Borrow to Earn scheme: users lock collateral (e.g. ADA), receive USD credit at 0 percent interest, and that credit must be routed into the Strike Liquidity Provider (SLP) vault. The simulator in borrow.html computes: credit = collateral value x draw percentage; final credit value = credit x (1 + SLP performance in the selected scenario); line health = final collateral equity / credit principal. The ADA price is fetched live from Strike's market API on every build; if that fails, the simulator asks the user for manual input. The SLP performance series comes from EarnScope's own tracker snapshots.

compare.name: Strike Vaults
compare.tagline: Copy-trading vaults: capital follows a leader's strategy. Performance is measured from real share price, not APR claims.
compare.methodology: Share price, equity, and depositor counts are taken from Strike's public API every ±5 minutes. 'Performance vs 1.0' = (share price / 1.0 - 1), measured since vault inception. 'Since tracker' measures from EarnScope's first snapshot. Leader commissions reduce returns and are already reflected in the share price.

compare.name: SLP + Strike Rewards
compare.tagline: Depositing in the SLP vault also earns Season 1 points that convert into STRIKE. The boost figures below are labeled ESTIMATE.

numbers.label: ESTIMATED STRIKE until season end per $1,000

compare.methodology: Official Season 1 parameters: 888 points per day split pro-rata based on time-weighted average deposits; 20,000 STRIKE pool; ±0.7508 STRIKE per point; season ends 28 Oct 2026. Strike computes points from hourly snapshots on their internal servers; the figures here reconstruct the pro-rata split from public SLP equity, so they are ESTIMATES, not official numbers.
data_gaps: Time-weighted average deposits per depositor are not publicly available; the pro-rata split is computed from the aggregate equity of the latest snapshot.

compare.name: Borrow to Earn
compare.tagline: Collateral (e.g. ADA) becomes 0 percent interest USD credit that must go into SLP: leveraged SLP exposure with no interest cost.
mechanism: Lock collateral, e.g. ADA worth C USD.
Draw USD credit equal to a draw percentage of C, at 0 percent interest.
The credit must be routed into the SLP vault.
Net result = credit value in SLP at the end of the horizon - credit principal.
Line health = final collateral equity / credit principal.
compare.methodology: The mechanism follows the official Borrow and Earn page at docs.strikefinance.org. The simulator uses the live ADA price from Strike's market API and historical SLP performance from EarnScope snapshots. The line health thresholds are EarnScope assumptions: Strike does not publish an official liquidation ratio.
data_gaps: The official liquidation / margin call ratio is not published.
The maximum draw percentage per collateral type is not published via the public API.

compare.name: Staking STRIKE
compare.tagline: Revenue sharing from Strike for STRIKE stakers.
compare.methodology: Strike's tokenomics state that stakers receive a share of revenue. However, no official APR is published through any public API we could find, and the official total staked cannot be derived from on-chain data (the staking registry is opt-in and stored on Strike's servers). EarnScope reports this as-is and does not invent numbers.
data_gaps: Staking APR / APY is not published.
Total STRIKE staked cannot be verified on-chain.

onchain.source: Koios (api.koios.rest): asset_addresses + asset_info, no API key required
onchain.methodology: Holder count and top-holder concentration are computed from all addresses holding the STRIKE asset via Koios asset_addresses (paginated); supply comes from asset_info; snapshots are taken once per day. The official total staked is NOT shown in this panel in any form: Strike's liquid staking uses an opt-in registry stored on Strike's servers (off-chain), so it cannot be derived from on-chain data. This panel does not invent staking numbers.

rewards.season_end_label: 28 Oct 2026 23:59 WIB (assumed closing time; the exact closing time is not yet verified)
rewards.methodology_note: ESTIMATE. Strike Rewards Season 1 distributes 888 points per day pro-rata based on time-weighted average deposits, computed from Strike's internal hourly snapshots. EarnScope does not have access to those internal snapshots, so this projection is reconstructed from public data: each SLP depositor's current equity position is used as a proxy for their time-weighted average deposit. The estimate covers only the remaining days until the season ends and may differ from Strike's official calculation. Conversion to STRIKE uses approximately 0.7508 STRIKE per point from the 20,000 STRIKE pool. These figures are NOT a promise of returns.
